name: Readeck
title: readeck.org
payoff: Save the story, cut the clutter
shortDescription: Readeck is a versatile content management tool designed for individuals who wish to organize web content effectively. It allows users to bookmark articles, photos, and videos for later access, making it ideal for researchers, students, and content curators. Users can archive, label, and search through their content, highlight important text, and even save video transcripts. An example use case could be a student collecting and organizing research materials for a thesis.
cons: May not support all video transcripts
